sections.name: Revenant
sections.card:
Summary: A flier on a jetpack: once it locks on, its rocket launchers fire a homing barrage. The claw swipe is its only other attack, and much weaker.
Looks like: Look for glowing green eyes and rocket launchers shaped like demon mouths.
Tips: Dash or double-jump and its missiles lose you. It sidesteps your fire with dashes of its own.

sections.name: Mancubus
sections.card:
Summary: A hulking, lumbering heavy demon with 3,500 health (490 staggered). It lobs fireballs from afar and torches you close in, with flamethrowers and a floor blast.
Weak points: Damage its arm cannons first: its attacks weaken and the flamethrowers shut off. Chainsaw or glory kill its chest: it explodes, hurting big demons nearby and sometimes killing small ones.
Looks like: Spot the bare, glowing yellow organ in its chest, shaped like a heart, and its greenish eyes.
Tips: Stay at range with heavy weapons; it is too slow to dodge the rocket launcher's rockets. The ballista can pick off its cannons from far away, and never let it corner you.

sections.name: Pinky
sections.card:
Summary: It mostly just charges at you. It has 1,000 health, but tail hits and the blood punch do bonus damage.
Weak points: Its tail has no armour, so go round the back and hit that. A direct blood punch kills it outright from any side.
Tips: Dodge its charge with a dash or double jump, or bait it into a wall to stun it. While it is stunned you can hit the tail, and an ice bomb stops it turning.

sections.name: Baron of Hell
sections.card:
Summary: A fast, aggressive demon with two flaming blades. One direct BFG shot will not kill it.
Looks like: Look for grey-brown, ash-coloured skin, fiery eyes and flesh that glows from inside like hot coals.
Tips: Stay just outside its leap range and rotate between the rocket launcher, ballista and super shotgun. A blood punch knocks it back for an easier stun, and steady chaingun fire stalls its attacks.

sections.name: Dread knight
sections.card:
Summary: A tougher cybernetic Hell knight, so anything that beats a Hell knight works on it too. Its arm blades reach farther in melee and throw an energy wave at range.
Tips: Dodge as soon as it crosses its arms, because an energy wave follows. One rocket lock-on burst staggers it, and rotating with the ballista and super shotgun keeps it flinching.

sections.name: Prowler
sections.card:
Summary: It pops up beside or behind you after a teleport, then pounces with a quick, hard-hitting melee strike. Its health is 1,000, or 250 staggered.
Weak points: Up close, a super shotgun blast kills it outright. A direct ballista hit staggers it instantly, and an ice bomb stops it teleporting.
Looks like: Purple hide, three eyes crowded mid-face, and bony plates sticking out of its back.
Tips: Keep checking around you when other demons keep you busy; it strikes while you are distracted. If it feels threatened it teleports away and sets up another ambush.

sections.name: Carcass
sections.card:
Summary: Not very tough: 1,200 health, or 240 staggered. It shoots ring lasers, sends floor shockwaves, and can wall itself or other demons behind a force field.
Weak points: Skip explosives on its force field; a plasma rifle shot or blood punch breaks it easily. Aim at the circular spot on its back tank for an instant kill.
Looks like: A zombie's upper body on a three-legged robot frame, with a blaster built into its right arm.
Tips: It usually shields staggered demons to stop your glory kills. A plasma rifle shot detonates a shield beside it; otherwise use two ballista shots or super shotgun blasts.

sections.name: Pain elemental
sections.card:
Summary: It flies, and its lost souls do the attacking: homing shots, ground mines or a barrage of three. Its health is close to a baron of Hell's.
Weak points: The rocket launcher's lock-on burst mod beats it: missiles follow it, and two volleys that land finish it. The ballista does bonus damage to it as well.
Looks like: Round, brown and airborne, with one big red eye and a pair of long black horns.
Tips: Shoot when it is busy or about to attack, because it air-dashes away from aimed weapons. Skip the meat hook, which may grab a lost soul; its mines splash even when they miss.

sections.name: Tyrant
sections.card:
Summary: A cybernetic demon that mostly fires missiles from an arm cannon. It returns as a major enemy, often in pairs later on, and survives one direct BFG hit.
Weak points: The Crucible kills it in one hit. Otherwise dash round behind it, since it turns slowly, and use the meat hook and super shotgun there.
Looks like: Look for four big horns on its head, yellowish-white eyes and bare ribs.
Tips: Attack in the pause it takes to aim after it spots you. Three beeps mean its laser is coming, so get behind cover or dash right at the end.

sections.name: Ballista
sections.card:
Summary: It fires slowly, but each straight-line beam hits harder than any other weapon's before mods. You get it once you return from Doom Hunter Base.
Uses: Each shot costs 25 cells: save it for faraway weak points and flying demons like the pain elemental. Its beam pierces whatever it kills, so line up fodder.
Tips: Arbalest: its dart sticks and blows up later, but you move slower and reload after every shot. Destroyer Blade costs 50 cells but hits a whole cluster with one wide, piercing blast.

sections.name: Heavy cannon
sections.card:
Summary: An automatic rifle that does a bit of everything, with the Precision Bolt and Micro Missiles mods. It is yours from the Hell on Earth level, after the second fight.
Uses: Aim at fodder from medium range or farther; two body shots kill most. The Precision Bolt mod hits weak spots hard, enough to wreck an arachnotron's cannon.
Tips: Use Precision Bolt on Maykr drones: a headshot makes them drop lots of resources. The cannon is hitscan, which suits fast fodder at long range that the plasma rifle cannot hit.

sections.name: Plasma rifle
sections.card:
Summary: A rapid-fire energy rifle that shoots small blue plasma orbs. It first turns up in Exultia, right after the portal.
Uses: Plasma fire blows up the energy shields that shield soldiers and carcasses carry, hurting them and nearby enemies. It also switches off a Doom hunter's body shield, but cannot touch arch-vile or marauder shields.
Tips: Several orbs in quick succession make an enemy burst, which can ruin a glory kill. Against a possessed demon, bring the Microwave Beam mod: it is the only thing that kills the spirit.

sections.name: Ice bomb
sections.card:
Summary: Shoot it from the shoulder launcher to ice a demon in place until enough damage breaks it apart. A toggle button picks it instead of the frag grenade.
Uses: Freeze a dangerous demon to stop its attacks or to escape, but you cannot glory kill it frozen. Use it on fast whiplashes, or to stop a pinky or spectre so you can hit its back.
Tips: Freezes last 4 seconds on most fodder, 2 on pinkies, 1.5 on mancubi and barons, 1 on tyrants. Possessed or screecher-buffed demons ignore it; cooldown is 45 seconds, or 35 upgraded.

sections.name: Flame belch
sections.card:
Summary: A short blast of flame from the shoulder launcher that sets enemies burning. You get it at the Fortress of Doom, and it works whatever grenade is selected.
Uses: Burning enemies drop armour shards, and more if they die on fire, making it your main armour source. Swing your aim side to side as you fire to hit a group; burning enemies take extra damage.
Tips: Its cooldown is 25 seconds, dropping to 12.5 once upgraded. Spend Sentinel crystals on belch upgrades to shorten it.

sections.name: Blood punch
sections.card:
Summary: Glory kills charge this melee strike, and its shockwave also hits enemies around the target. You first find it as a glowing artifact in Exultia.
Uses: Use it to kill or badly hurt pinkies and spectres, and to break shields, even the arch-vile's. It also tends to hit weak points, and can destroy a cyber-mancubus's armour.
Tips: Early on, two glory kills make one charge and you hold one; it upgrades as you clear missions. On a fodder crowd, ice bomb and flame belch them, then punch one to refill health and armour.
